# sort

Sort, merge or check text records through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/sort input.txt

moonx cli/sort -n numbers.txt

moonx cli/sort -t : -k 2,2 -s records.txt
```

Use C-locale byte ordering by default. Numeric, general numeric, human, month, version and random orders are available.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-r`, `--reverse` | Reverse the comparison order. |
| `-n`, `--numeric-sort` | Compare numeric values. |
| `-s`, `--stable` | Retain input order for equal selected keys. |
| `-o VALUE`, `--output VALUE` | Write named output; - is a literal filename. |
| `-S VALUE`, `--buffer-size VALUE` | Sorting budget; default 64 MiB; bare numbers use KiB. |
| `-u`, `--unique` | Keep one record per equal comparison key. |
| `-k VALUE`, `--key VALUE` | Select the comparison field or range. |
| `-t VALUE`, `--field-separator VALUE` | Use this byte as the field separator. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Sorting uses a default 64 MiB accounted buffer and temporary runs; this is not an RSS limit. Nonzero percentage budgets are unsupported.
- Merge-only output over existing files can be refused when source/output identity cannot be established. Use a new output path.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
